name: drift-raw-dev
creation_methodology: Human-authored prospective Phase III cases using the frozen six-label taxonomy; balanced by label and reviewed deterministically for unique IDs and distributions.
known_limitations: The adapter training dataset could not be recovered, so true independence from training cannot be established.
Ground truth was authored and reviewed by one engineering agent rather than multiple independent domain annotators.
Each case has one dominant label; multi-change detection requires a separate project-level dataset.
This dataset is development evidence and must not become the future sealed final-test set.
